movelist.name: Heal Block
movelist.effect: Until the end of the encounter, the target may not gain Hit Points or Temporary Hit Points from any source. This effect ends if the target is switched out or Takes a Breather.

movelist.name: Hex
movelist.effect: Once a Scene, if Hex’s target has a Status Affliction, you may have Hex’s Damage Base be 13 instead (4d10+10 / 35).

movelist.name: Shadow Claw
movelist.effect: Shadow Claw is a Critical Hit on 18+.

movelist.name: Earth Power
movelist.effect: Earth Power lowers the Special Defense of all Legal Targets 1 Combat Stage on 16+.

abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.effect: The Pokémon resists Ground-Type Moves one step further, and gains a Levitate Speed of 4, or has existing Levitate Speeds increased by +2. Defensive.

abilities.name: Bully
abilities.trigger: The user hits a target for Super-Effective
abilities.effect: The target of the attack is pushed 2 Meters, becomes Tripped, and gains an Injury.

abilities.name: Soulstealer
abilities.trigger: The user’s attack causes a foe to Faint
abilities.effect: The user removes one Injury from themselves and gains Hit Points equal to 25% of their Max Hit Points. If the triggering attack killed its target, the user instead removes all Injuries and recovers Hit Points equal to 50% of the user’s Max Hit Points.
